capabilities: Browse vault folders in a dual-pane tree and open folder contents in an adjacent tab
Select files with click, Ctrl/Cmd+Click, Shift+Click, and drag-to-select marquee
Copy, cut, paste, rename, and delete files with keyboard shortcuts and context menus
Move files via drag-and-drop within and across explorer tabs
Navigate with an editable address bar, breadcrumbs, and mouse back/forward buttons
disambiguation: Not a replacement for the sidebar file explorer; it runs as its own interactive tab in the central workspace area.
extras: Author states the plugin is AI-generated and that they are not a programmer; mobile and touch support is explicitly marked NOT TESTED.
motivation: The author states it was AI-generated for personal use and hosted publicly because they believe it can benefit other people as well.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer lacks Windows Explorer-style multi-selection, clipboard operations, dual-pane browsing, and mouse-forward/back navigation inside a workspace tab.

relations.evidence: hook into Obsidian's full native menu suite (Bookmarks, Search, Templater, etc.)

summary: File-manager tab that shows the vault as an expandable folder tree with Explorer-style selection, clipboard, drag-and-drop, and keyboard navigation.
